name: pokemon-explorer
description: Explorador de Pokémon: Angular 21 + NestJS (Backend for Frontend sobre PokéAPI)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix bff && npm install --prefix web
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n bff,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start:dev --prefix bff" "npm start --prefix web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix bff && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.test: npm test --prefix bff && npm run test:e2e --prefix bff && npm test --prefix web -- --watch=false
